Description.Value: Comprehensive balance overhaul and essential UI enhancements. Features tactical ability rebalancing, weapon/armor adjustments, facility improvements, QoL UI additions, and bug fixes from TFTV and original AA. AAP 1.1: silent no-op fixes (ability costs, armor stats, personal abilities, vehicle ammo, loot, repair costs, Access Lift), configurable options (native ModConfig), and native support for Festering Skies (Behemoth/flyer slowdown) and Corrupted Horizons (Acheron nerf) alongside Kaos Engines. Mainly cribbing some notes off OG AA and https://github.com/Voland163/TFTV with some of my really-old ideas and bit of brainstorming
